response.original_title: {FAQ™Extra Room} Can I Add an Extra Room to My Crystal Cruise Reservation?
response.overview: You can add an additional room to an existing Crystal Cruise reservation by calling Viking customer service at +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) contacting your travel agent. To add an additional room or cabin to an existing Crystal Cruises 1-866-254-7549 reservation, you must book a separate stateroom and call customer service at 1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or 44-120-420-8151 (UK) or contact your travel advisor To add an extra room to an existing reservation, visit Crystal Cruises or call customer service at +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) to book a separate stateroom and link the bookings, as this cannot be done online. You can add another room to an existing Crystal Cruise booking by calling customer service at +1-866-254-7549 (US) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK)
